name: Grok Bot Notify
description: Forwards Orca agent status changes to a webhook. Built for Grok Bot webhook routines; works with any HTTP endpoint.

settings.title: Webhook URL
settings.description: HTTP(S) endpoint that receives agent status POSTs.

settings.title: Debounce seconds
settings.description: Minimum seconds between identical state POSTs for the same terminal or pane.

settings.title: Authorization value
settings.description: paste the Authorization header value here once; the worker moves it into encrypted secrets and clears this field
